rdfs:label: alsoKnownAs
rdfs:comment: An alternate identifier for an ActivityStreams Object — in account migration, a previous identity of an actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service), listed by the new account to show it consents to the move.
notes: Standard fediverse account-migration pattern: the *new* account lists the old one in `alsoKnownAs`, the *old* account sets `movedTo` to the new one and sends a `Move`. Receivers accept the Move only if the target's `alsoKnownAs` contains the origin, which proves the new account consented. Extension term (in the AS2 JSON-LD context, not the AS2 Vocabulary REC); DID Core reuses this same IRI for DID `alsoKnownAs`.

examples.title: A migrated Person pointing back at the old identity
